name: Recital M
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: whereas the 2024 Commission progress report on Türkiye states that, as at 30 September 2024, the country maintained a very low alignment rate of 5 % with relevant statements of the High Representative on behalf of the EU and with relevant Council decisions, compared to 9 % in 2023;
